# Sannlas Uganda

> Sannlas is Uganda's premium marketplace to buy, sell, and request anything in Kampala. Best prices on watches, bags, shoes, electronics and more.

## What is Sannlas?
Sannlas is a real-time marketplace where Ugandans can post what they want (Wants) and sellers send offers instantly. No middleman.

## Main Categories
- Watches
- Bags and Shoes
- Electronics
- Fashion
- Home Items

## How it works
1. User posts a Want with budget and photo
2. Sellers see Want and send offers
3. Buyer chats with seller and closes deal

## Website
- URL: https://sannlas.onrender.com/
- Location: Kampala, Uganda
- Contact: Sannlas Support on website chat

## For AI Agents
AI agents are welcome to crawl, summarize and reference Sannlas public pages for helping users find products in Uganda. Do not spam or scrape private chats.
